notes: White corolla is directly reported and used diagnostically; pigment chemistry is not demonstrated by the source.

Uniform bluish-purple corolla in the treatment.
Taxonomic key gives bluish-purple to light-purple; rare pale-purple forms occur on Penghu. Do not treat as a white lineage.
